title: First local variable address
statement: Let $W$ be a word size, let $Z$ be a layout with $F$ local variables, and suppose $m$ satisfies the storage relation for a state $\sigma$ and frame pointer $q$: in particular, it stores $\sigma_{\mathrm{loc}}(x)$ at stack address $q+x$ for every $x<F$. If $F>0$, then $m$ at the stack address $q$ equals the encoding of $\sigma_{\mathrm{loc}}(0)$.
